cool-the-block.method: Lowest tree-canopy coverage (0.2%) among 36 grid cells scanned across Baltimore.

reclaim-the-lot.method: Highest concentration of vacant building notices (3197 exact count, via returnCountOnly) among 36 grid cells scanned. Map overlay shows a capped sample of 1000 points.
